visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A middle-aged man with short black hair wearing a white chef's uniform and clear plastic gloves enters a brightly lit television studio. He is walking towards the camera when an off-screen hand presents a vacuum-sealed package of frozen milkfish. Large colorful text appears overlaying the screen. (2) A graphic screen with a solid light beige background displays large, bold dark blue and teal Chinese characters centered on the screen. The text asks a question about how to fry fish without causing oil explosions. A large teal question mark is visible on the right side. (3) The chef stands in a modern kitchen studio setting with stainless steel appliances and dark wood cabinetry visible behind him. He holds the vacuum-packed fish in his left hand and gestures with his right hand while explaining cooking techniques. He maintains a cheerful facial expression. (4) In a close-up shot, the chef demonstrates the first step of preparing the fish. He uses his gloved hands to sprinkle fine white salt onto a piece of raw milkfish that has been removed from its packaging and placed on a white square plate with a dark rim. (5) The camera captures a close-up of the chef's hands as he performs the second step. He takes a thick white paper towel and firmly presses it down onto the surface of the salted milkfish to absorb excess moisture. The fish rests on the same white and dark-rimmed plate. (6) The chef is shown in a medium shot holding a black non-stick frying pan. He demonstrates the third step by placing the dried milkfish fillet into the cold pan before turning on the heat. The kitchen environment includes a black stovetop and various cooking utensils. (7) A close-up view of the black frying pan shows the fish inside. The chef carefully layers two sheets of white paper towel over the milkfish fillet while it is in the pan. This is described as the fourth step to prevent oil from splashing out during the frying process. (8) Continuing the demonstration in the pan, the chef performs the fifth step by placing a glass and metal lid onto the frying pan, covering the paper towels and the fish completely. He then looks towards the camera with a confident and encouraging facial expression. (9) Another graphic screen appears with a light beige background. It features large, bold teal Chinese text that asks if an oven can also be used to cook the milkfish. The layout is clean and minimalist, mirroring the previous question-based graphic screen. (10) The chef is seen leaning down towards a large commercial-style oven. He pulls out a metal rack holding a tray with a piece of cooked, golden-brown milkfish. He points towards the fish and smiles, indicating that the oven is a successful alternative cooking method. (11) A third graphic screen with the same beige background and teal text asks if an air fryer can be used for the fish. The text is centered and clearly legible, maintaining the consistent visual style used throughout the tutorial segments of the video. (12) The chef stands next to a white and black air fryer on a kitchen counter. He points one finger up while holding the air fryer's basket handle with his other hand. He explains the settings for air frying the fish while maintaining high energy and a friendly tone. (13) The chef holds up a large cardboard poster featuring a high-quality photograph of a cooked milkfish dish with lemon slices. The poster includes text about a group buying promotion. He points to the dish and gestures enthusiastically to encourage viewers to participate. (14) The final screen features a light beige background with two brand logos. On the left is a circular logo for "美食通" and on the right is the colorful "型男大主廚" logo. Text above the logos mentions an exclusive group buy discount, concluding the promotional video.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with high-tempo, upbeat pop music with a strong electronic beat. A high-pitched female voice screams "Baby Chef, save me!" with high emotional arousal. This is immediately followed by a cartoonish "whoosh" sound effect as text appears on the screen. (2) The music continues at a steady pace of approximately 125 BPM. The male chef begins speaking in a friendly, professional, and high-energy narrative tone. His speech is clear and well-enunciated. A "pop" sound effect punctuates the transition to the first cooking instructional graphic. (3) As the chef describes the five cooking tips, his voice remains energetic and persuasive. Each new step is introduced with a quick "ding" or "ting" sound effect. The background music maintains a consistent volume under the chef's voice, providing a lively and encouraging atmosphere. (4) During the demonstration of sprinkling salt and wiping the fish, the sound of paper towels rustling is clearly audible over the music. The chef's vocal pitch remains moderately high and engaging. The background music's beat remains prominent, driving the fast pacing of the instructional segments. (5) When discussing the oven and air fryer options, the chef's tone becomes even more enthusiastic. A digital "ping" sound occurs as he mentions the temperature and time settings. The music swells slightly during transitions between the question screens and the chef's live-action responses. (6) The final promotional segment features the chef speaking at a faster rate with high vocal dominance, urging the audience to join the group buy. The music reaches a crescendo before a final "stinger" sound effect marks the end of the video as the brand logos appear.
